posts.headline: She turned a *one-room school* into her village's pride
posts.sub: How one teacher in rural Maharashtra brought 200 children back to class.

slides.title: Half the children had *stopped coming*
slides.body: In 2019 the school had one room, no toilets and attendance below 50%. Families sent children to work in the fields instead.

slides.title: Classes moved outdoors, parents were invited in
slides.body: She ran evening sessions for parents and turned the courtyard into a reading space.

slides.title: Attendance is now *above 95%*
slides.body: The village panchayat and a local company foundation helped add two classrooms and a library.

posts.takeaway: One person who refuses to give up can *change a whole village*.

posts.headline: A village that ran dry every summer now has *water all year*
posts.body: Farmers dug and deepened 12 farm ponds with help from a company foundation. Two years on, wells stay full through May and families no longer migrate for work.
